column1: # Connected negotiated-compression command I/O source evidence.

column5: The existing production PacketIoReader and PacketIoWriter now have a server consumer: handshake-selected none/zlib/zstd mode and zstd level feed sequence-zero command reads, sequence-one response writes, and flush/reset semantics around Connection dispatch. BufferedReadConn/net.Conn ownership, dynamic config, deadlines, byte metrics, terror logging, mysql.ErrBadConn conversion, and mutable in-place buffers remain external.

A parsed handshake compression snapshot now drives generic packet I/O around Connection::dispatch_framed_auto for COM_QUERY, COM_PING, and COM_QUIT, preserving zlib-before-zstd selection, response sequence one, no-response quit, and command-boundary reset. Earlier result-set, error, auth/session, and bounded catalog dispatch artifacts remain intact. Live sockets, TLS/auth execution, run-loop status and kill handling, ERR response writing, incremental result streaming, unsupported commands, prepared statements, metrics, and full lifecycle remain external.
